# Travel China Guide

> > Comprehensive travel resource for exploring China's destinations, attractions, cuisine, and cultural festivals across provinces including Shanghai, Sichuan, Yunnan, Hunan, and Hainan.

Travel China Guide provides detailed information on Chinese cities, historical sites, regional cuisines, and cultural traditions. The site covers major destinations from coastal resorts to mountain landscapes, classical gardens to Tibetan monasteries, helping travelers plan trips across China's diverse regions.

## Key Topics

- Shanghai
- Sichuan
- Yunnan
- Hunan
- Hainan
- Yu Garden (Yuyuan Garden)
- Ming Dynasty
- Eight Cuisines (regional cooking)
- Dragon Boat Festival (Duanwu)
- Classical gardens
- Tibetan culture
- Chinese festivals
- Travel planning
- Regional attractions

## Major Destinations & City Guides

- [Zhangjiajie Travel: A Full Guide on Tour Planning, Things to Do](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/cityguides/hunan/zhangjiajie/): Zhangjiajie travel guide: sandstone peaks, glass bridge & tour planning
- [Shangri-La Yunnan: Tibetan Monasteries, Snow Mountains & Gorges](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/cityguides/yunnan/shangri-la/): Shangri-La Yunnan: Tibetan monasteries, snow mountains & gorges guide
- [Haikou Hainan: A Coastal City with Beaches and Seaside Resorts](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/cityguides/hainan/haikou/): Haikou travel guide: Hainan's coastal capital with beaches & resorts

## Attractions & Historical Sites

- [Yu Garden, Shanghai Yuyuan Garden Opening Hours, Ticket](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/attraction/shanghai/yuyuan_garden.htm): Yu Garden Shanghai: 400-year Ming Dynasty garden with hours & tickets

- [8 Chinese Cuisines: Sichuan, Shandong, Canton, Jiangsu, Zhejiang...](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/intro/cuisine_drink/cuisine/eight_cuisines.htm): Guide to China's 8 major regional cuisines: Sichuan, Canton & more
